title: "Corrected batch-effect analysis"
author: "Christian Halter"
output: rmdformats::downcute

# Approved release scope

Eight enabled physical cohorts produce nine evaluation entries because Kidney
condition and tissue are separate. Nine methods including NULL and exactly two
unsupervised correction arms produce 405 finite five-metric values. The two arms
are `ecoda_unsupervised_harmony` and `ecoda_unsupervised_harmony_limma`; the
ambiguous historical corrected `ECODA_seuratres_2` is never substituted. Its
uncorrected counterpart retains its original key.

Provide the explicit approved release control and its MD5 through
`ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL` and `ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL_MD5`. Both batch
views and their current sample metadata must be covered for paired MDS. Missing
new results stop the report; there is no legacy or offline-snapshot fallback.
Only small result/metadata artifacts are read, one cohort at a time. No H5AD,
method fit, correction or Pipeline 4 annotation is run or rewritten here.

Kidney tissue labels are the recorded sampling categories: 45 generic kidney
samples (cells), 23 cortex and 12 medulla (nuclei). Tissue is partly confounded
with `suspension_type`. The two evaluations use identical features/distances and
MDS coordinates within each view; neither is protected in batch correction.
Primary NULL uses its actual stored shuffle, while tissue NULL has seed 124 and
its exact labels recorded in the derived release provenance.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") setwd("..")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(funkyheatmap)
})
source("src/utils/load_all_functions.R")
source("src/utils/analysis_release.R")
source("src/utils/evaluation_scores.R")
source("src/utils/batch_effect_analysis.R")
control_path <- Sys.getenv("ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL")
control_md5 <- Sys.getenv("ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL_MD5")
view <- "batch_effect_corrected"
control <- read_batch_release_control(control_path, control_md5, view)
uncorrected_control <- read_batch_release_control(control_path, control_md5, "batch_effect_uncorrected")
datasets <- control$datasets; batch_datasets <- names(datasets)
selected_methods <- batch_release_method_keys(view)
stopifnot(!"ECODA_seuratres_2" %in% selected_methods,
  all(c("ecoda_unsupervised_harmony", "ecoda_unsupervised_harmony_limma") %in% selected_methods),
  !anyNA(method_label_map_main[selected_methods]))
set.seed(42)
options(mc.cores = 1L)
# Validate every required new result and complete both score grids before figures.
report <- score_batch_release(control)
uncorrected_report <- score_batch_release(uncorrected_control)
stopifnot(nrow(report$scores) == 405L, nrow(uncorrected_report$scores) == 360L)
plot_root <- file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_corrected")
analysis_output_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", view, control$release_id)
```

# Five-metric funkyheatmap and metric panels

Biological MDS subtitles show the same scaled five-metric entry means, including
NULL in the comparison ranges. Technical colourings show individual raw metrics
or an explicit unscorable status for constant axes.

ANOSIM, adjusted modularity (`k=3`), the mean Ward/PAM ARI, Silhouette and LISI
separation all enter the arithmetic mean equally. LISI is already higher-is-better
and is not inverted. Scaling is within dataset/view/evaluation/metric, with
neutral 0.5 for constant ranges. Kidney's two entries have equal weight to the
other evaluations. All five right-hand metric summaries and separate raw metric
plots are retained; runtime is excluded from this batch comparison.

```{r five-metric-report, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_batch_release_artifact(report, file.path(analysis_output_root, "evaluation_release.rds"))
write_batch_release_artifact(report$scores, file.path(analysis_output_root, "heatmap_scores.csv"), csv = TRUE)
plot_data <- report$scores
plot_data$method <- plot_data$method_key; plot_data$score <- plot_data$metric
dir.create(plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
build_funky_heatmap(plot_data, exec_times = NULL,
  filter_methods = selected_methods, method_recode = method_label_map_main,
  dataset_recode = setNames(batch_datasets, batch_datasets), score_set = evaluation_metrics(),
  output_file = "batch_effect_corrected_funkyheatmap.pdf", output_dir = plot_root,
  plot_width = 14, plot_height = 8, expected_grid = control$expected_grid)
for (metric in evaluation_metrics()) {
  rows <- plot_data[plot_data$metric == metric, ]
  rows$entry <- paste(rows$dataset, rows$evaluation_id, sep = " / ")
  plot <- ggplot(rows, aes(method_key, value, fill = method_key)) + geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~entry, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = metric, title = "Raw separation metric; higher is better")
  ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0("batch_effect_corrected_", metric, ".pdf")), plot, width = 14, height = 9)
}
```

# Paired MDS and current-cohort confounding tables

Uncorrected panels are left and corrected panels right. Both corrected Harmony
arms compare with the same uncorrected unsupervised result. Each method's MDS
coordinates are computed once per view and reused for both Kidney axes and all
technical colourings. Primary biological filenames and batch suffixes are
preserved; Kidney tissue also uses the maintained `_mds_region.pdf` filename,
now explicitly labeled with the recorded tissue categories.

```{r batch-mds, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (dataset in batch_datasets) {
  left <- load_batch_release_dataset(uncorrected_control, dataset)
  right <- load_batch_release_dataset(control, dataset)
  panels <- plot_batch_release_comparison(left, right, datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col,
    method_label_map_main[selected_methods])
  for (name in names(panels)) {
    suffix <- if (name == "biological") "" else paste0("_", name)
    ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_mds", suffix, ".pdf")), panels[[name]], width = 13, height = 24)
    if (name == "evaluation_tissue") ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_mds_region.pdf")), panels[[name]], width = 13, height = 24)
  }
  for (axis in names(right$evaluations)) {
    stem <- if (axis == right$primary_evaluation) dataset else paste0(dataset, "_", axis)
    write_batch_biology_tables(right$metadata, stem, datasets[[dataset]]$evaluation_labels[[axis]],
      datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col, file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_bio_vs_batch"),
      file.path(analysis_output_root, "bio_vs_batch"), lane = control$release_id)
  }
  rm(left, right, panels)
}
```

The maintained corrected funkyheatmap is
`plots/batch_effect_corrected/batch_effect_corrected_funkyheatmap.pdf`. Primary
MDS files remain `<dataset>_mds.pdf` and technical files retain their configured
`_mds_batch_<column>.pdf` and `_mds_batch_combined.pdf` suffixes. Separate metric
PDFs use the five core metric keys. The new release owns its score/provenance
snapshot and checksum sidecars under the explicit release ID. Source bundles
and historical snapshots remain immutable; plots are not declared current until
all required release rows are approved.
